name: stm32-project-tools
description: Build CMake preset variants and flash STM32 firmware from the Explorer context menu.

stm32ProjectTools.cmakePath.description: CMake executable. Empty means auto-detect from STM32Cube bundles or PATH. Environment variables such as ${env:LOCALAPPDATA} are supported.

stm32ProjectTools.programmerPath.description: STM32_Programmer_CLI executable. Empty means auto-detect from STM32Cube bundles or PATH.

stm32ProjectTools.projectsDirectory.description: Project container directory relative to the workspace root.

stm32ProjectTools.boardCacheVariable.description: CMake preset cache variable whose value matches the project directory name.

stm32ProjectTools.interface.description: Debug probe interface used by STM32CubeProgrammer.
